entries: You can place a Weapon Enchantment on each of your Clockwork Constructs' integrated weapons. Your Constructs gain the benefits of this enchantment and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Conspiracy Theorist
entries: {@i Unravel Far-Reaching, Incredulous Conspiracies}

The world is full of stuff that doesn't add up. A natural disaster strikes and they talk about theoretical weather patterns. People forget days at a time and they say some medical jargon about their brains. And nobody seems to notice the folks dressed in black who lurk behind every corner. It's one big coincidence after another. But when you ask the right questions and pull on the right threads, you start uncovering the biggest mysteries: the ones They don't want you to know about.

It's hard to tell who They even are, apart from the fact that They're massively influential and have deep pockets. They have agents everywhere, watching and waiting. What are their goals? What are they working so hard to keep secret? You can't be totally sure, but you have a few good theories.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Arcane Relics
entries: When you take the {@action Ready|XPHB} action, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make for the {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. You can only use this feature when the trigger is in response to another creature's action or movement after the end of your turn.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Connect the Dots
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, choose one skill. You gain proficiency in that skill if you lacked it and {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} with it. This proficiency and {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} lasts until you use this feature to choose a different skill.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Off the Grid
entries: Your ability to avoid others grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Escape Plan
entries: Whenever you take damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Nondetection
entries: You can cast {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} on yourself without a spell slot.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Containment Specialist
entries: {@i Contain and Conceal Anomalous Magic Artifacts}

Though the study of magic is diverse and wonderous, it contains mysteries better left unexplored. Such topics in magic are seldom studied, for their very existence poses an existential threat to the multiverse itself: chronomancy, protomancy, and quantumancy are among the few graced with names at all. When a sinister (or merely curious) arcanist pulls on one of these threads of knowledge, they open a Pandora's box of unpredictable effects. The results are usually catastrophic. Such dangerous arcana leaves lasting scars on people and objects, metaphysical reverberations of the terrible secrets at their source.

As their title implies, Containment Specialists are tasked with tracking, isolating, and containing exotic magic and its artifacts. Their job is hazardous and challenging, but is of critical importance to the multiverse at large. Containment Specialists often coordinate in clandestine groups to triangulate new threats and ensure isolated ones remain indefinitely contained. With some luck, these organizations can remain obscure footnotes for generations, further sheltering their secrets from curious eyes.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Arcane Disruption
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Exploit Weakness|Investigator|ValdaSpire24|5} and the target has the Magic Resistance trait, that trait doesn't function until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Nothing to See Here
entries: With a blinding flash, you can overwrite the memories of those around you. You can cast {@spell Modify Memory|XPHB} as an action targeting up to 3 creatures within range without a spell slot or components. You must modify the memories of each creature affected by the spell in the same way.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Containment Dimension
entries: You can leverage a powerful quarantine procedure to keep others safe from dangerous artifacts. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can create a pocket dimension that is an exact duplicate of your surroundings at the moment you use this feature—complete with duplicates of all the structures and nonmagical items therein—and transport creatures you choose within its area to the dimension. You decide the exact area of the duplicate dimension, as long as its total space fits within a 150-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}.

While in the pocket dimension, you can only affect and be affected by other creatures in that dimension. You can't see creatures and objects outside the pocket dimension. Objects taken from the pocket dimension vanish upon leaving it.

If a creature leaves the bounds of the pocket dimension it appears in the corresponding space on the plane it left. If it appears in an occupied space, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes {@damage 4d6} Force damage.

The pocket dimension lasts for 10 minutes, and ends early if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the pocket dimension contains no creatures, or you dismiss it (no action required). When the pocket dimension ends, all creatures and objects are returned to the plane they left in their corresponding locations.
Once you use this feature to create a pocket dimension, you can't do so until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Corpse Florist
entries: {@i Cultivate a Garden of Corpses}

Some Necromancers arrive at the realization that Necromancy is the gateway to new life flourishing in the rot and waste of the recently dead. Perhaps unsurprisingly, horticulture is their main inspiration.

Instead of animating corpses normally, Corpse Florists plant seeds of the corpse flower in recently deceased bodies, which sprouts and sends creeping vines to every joint and muscle group. Within minutes, the corpse rises under the florist's control, but as a blossoming Plant instead of a mindless Undead. A Corpse Florist travels with their shambling garden wherever they go, planting new corpse flowers and revitalizing the earth whenever the opportunity presents itself.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Rotten Seed
entries: You can plant your budding corpse flowers in the living as well as the dead. You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to toss a seed at an enemy that you can see within 15 feet of you, which makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a corpse flower seedling sprouts and burrows into the creature's flesh. At the start of each of the creature's turns, it takes {@damage 1d8} Necrotic damage and you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.
The seedling withers and dies after 1 minute, when the target dies, or when you use this feature again.
The damage of this feature changes when you reach level 11 ({@dice 1d10}) and 17 ({@dice 1d12}).

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Death in Bloom
entries: Once on each of your turns when a Medium or Small creature under the effect of your Rotten Seed dies, you can animate that creature's corpse as a {@creature Skeleton|ValdaSpire24}, {@creature Spirit|ValdaSpire24}, or {@creature Zombie|ValdaSpire24} (your choice) under your control. This Undead counts as one of your thralls and gains the benefit of your Garden of the Grave.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Botanical Lich [Lichdom]
entries: You have reached the pinnacle of Necromancy and transformed yourself into a lich. Your body becomes a fertile garden of flowers that bloom from every inch of your skin, and exotic flowers bloom in your wake. You gain the following benefits in addition to those of your {@classFeature Lichdom|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|20} feature.

entries.name: Spirit Flowers
entries: Your spirit jar is a set of thirteen immortal flowers of different types located in places important to you. Each one has a specific weakness, which you must discuss with your GM. When you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you reform in the soil at your nearest spirit flower.

entries.name: Petal Stride
entries: Flowers sprout from the ground in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn to step into a flower and teleport to any other flower you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do so, you can choose any number of friendly Plants within 30 feet of you and cause them to teleport to flowers you can see within range.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you regain 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or you are in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Courtiers' Guild
entries: {@i Look Sharp, Dress Sharper}

The Courtiers' Guild works less with steel and more with fabric and lace. Dressmakers, tailors, hatters, and accessorists, these craftsmen specialize in making their wealthy clientele look their very best. No other craftsperson possesses a keener eye for fashion or a swifter needle and thread, and few can pass as easily in royal attire as a well-dressed courtier.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Petticoat Plate
entries: You can add all the customizations of your Customize Armor feature to a suit of Masterwork armor. Only you gain the benefits of these customizations on this suit of armor.
When you reach Craftsman level 13, you can also apply every enchantment of your Armor Enchantment feature to a suit of Masterwork armor.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Rapid Suturing
entries: You can stitch wounds together as neatly as fabric. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can stitch the wounds of a willing creature within 5 feet of you, causing it to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Craftsman level.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Masterwork Bonus. You regain one expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Adventuring Couture
entries: When you use the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} of your Glow-Up, you can inspire each ally that you can see within 30 feet of you that is wearing an item with a Cosmetic Enchantment. Each creature gains {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} and {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Craftsman level.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Crone
entries: {@i Brew Foul Potions and Lay Fouler Curses}

The oldest and most insidious necromantic secrets are remembered by hag's covens. Their curses have plagued the likes of elves and humans since before the dawn of history, becoming more malicious and complex with the passing centuries.

Necromancers that consort with hags or join a hag's coven to learn their necromantic secrets are known as "crones" by their peers and "haglings" by others. For their devotion to the hag's ancient arts, these Necromancers learn to spin terrible curses, brew potions in a cauldron, and even access the mythical Baba Yaga's arcane secrets.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Witch's Cauldron
entries: You can spend 10 minutes to brew potions, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, expending 10 {@classFeature Charnel Touch|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|1} points for each potion you brew. You can have a total number of potions at one time up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). These potions retain potency until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, after which they become inert.

The following potions are available to you: {@item Potion of Animal Friendship|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Climbing|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Healing|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Resistance|XDMG}, and {@item Potion of Water Breathing|XDMG}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Nefarious Ruse
entries: You master a handful of hag tricks, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Conceal Thralls
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 10 {@classFeature Charnel Touch|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|1} points to give your thralls the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. This condition ends early for a thrall that makes an attack roll or deals damage.

entries.name: Thrall Transposition
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can choose one of your thralls within 30 feet of you. You both teleport, swapping places.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Baba Yaga [Lichdom]
entries: You have reached the pinnacle of Necromancy and transformed yourself into a lich. By mastering the subtle magic of hags and witches, you can wield the full power of a coven and curse others with unparalleled foulness. You gain the following benefits in addition to those of your {@classFeature Lichdom|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|20} feature.

entries.name: Accursed Touch
entries: When you deal 25 or more damage with {@classFeature Charnel Touch|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|1}, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws until the start of your next turn, and your thralls have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the target.

entries.name: Flying Broom
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to enchant a mundane object—such as a broom, cauldron, or rug—with the power of flight. While holding this item, you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to 60 feet, as long as you aren't wearing Medium or Heavy armor. This object remains enchanted until you use this benefit to enchant a different object.

entries.name: Baba Yaga Spells
entries: You can expend {@classFeature Charnel Touch|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|1} points to cast one of the spells from the following table without a spell slot.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Daggermark
entries: {@i Use Stealth and Subterfuge to Achieve Victory}

Captains that bear the Daggermark—a tattoo, scar, or insignia representing a blade—utilize stealth and clandestine tactics to defeat their foes. Though they prefer ambushes and assassinations, they may acquiesce to direct confrontation if they have an underhanded tactic up their sleeve to safeguard victory. These Captains might be leaders in a Thieves' Guild, career assassins, or bandit captains that mark their closest confidants with the Daggermark to induct them into their ranks.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Flanking Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, the next attack roll made by an ally against the target before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Evasion
entries: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feature if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. Your Cohort also gains the benefits of this feature.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Preemptive Strike
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack against you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one attack with a weapon against the attacker. Resolve your attack before the triggering attack.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Daggermark

entries: {@color {@style Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the {@color {@class Captain|ValdaSpire24}|3B7DAF} class|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}
{@color {@style Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}

{@i Use Stealth and Subterfuge to Achieve Victory}

Captains that bear the Daggermark—a tattoo, scar, or insignia representing a blade—utilize stealth and clandestine tactics to defeat their foes. Though they prefer ambushes and assassinations, they may acquiesce to direct confrontation if they have an underhanded tactic up their sleeve to safeguard victory. These Captains might be leaders in a Thieves' Guild, career assassins, or bandit captains that mark their closest confidants with the Daggermark to induct them into their ranks.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Flanking Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, the next attack roll made by an ally against the target before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Evasion
entries: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feature if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. Your Cohort also gains the benefits of this feature.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Preemptive Strike
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack against you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one attack with a weapon against the attacker. Resolve your attack before the triggering attack.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Daggermark

entries: {@color {@style Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the {@color {@class Captain|ValdaSpire24}|3B7DAF} class|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}
{@color {@style Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}
{@color {@style The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}

entries.name: Cross-Compatability Modifications
entries: {@b Level 10: Evasion.} You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws.
{@i Use Stealth and Subterfuge to Achieve Victory}

Captains that bear the Daggermark—a tattoo, scar, or insignia representing a blade—utilize stealth and clandestine tactics to defeat their foes. Though they prefer ambushes and assassinations, they may acquiesce to direct confrontation if they have an underhanded tactic up their sleeve to safeguard victory. These Captains might be leaders in a Thieves' Guild, career assassins, or bandit captains that mark their closest confidants with the Daggermark to induct them into their ranks.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Flanking Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, the next attack roll made by an ally against the target before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Evasion
entries: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feature if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. Your Cohort also gains the benefits of this feature.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Preemptive Strike
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack against you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one attack with a weapon against the attacker. Resolve your attack before the triggering attack.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Dead Mist Acolyte
entries: {@i Sacrifice Your Life-Force for Necromantic Power}

Deep in the starry expanse of the Astral Plane, Necromancers can find a pure, untapped necromantic source: the Dead Mists. This inky astral fog is an embodiment of unlife in the multiverse, perhaps a negative balance to the overwhelming majority of living creatures. However, the Dead Mists is a living and corruptive entity that drains the life essence from anything it touches.

Necromancers that survive their first experimentations in the Dead Mists might become its acolytes and spend their waking hours unraveling its astral secrets. Perhaps they will learn to coax life essence back out of the necromantic cloud, or perhaps they will learn to summon aspects of the mists to plague their foes. Regardless, they will pay the price for their ambitions as the mists slowly drain their mortality.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gaseous Escape
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you take damage, you can cast {@spell Gaseous Form|XPHB} on yourself. The spell's effects apply against the triggering damage. When you cast the spell with this feature, you can end it at the start of your turn (no action required).
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Duskfog
entries: When you perform your {@classFeature Thralls|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|2|ValdaSpire24|Animate Thralls} ritual, you can summon one or more {@creature Duskfog|ValdaSpire24|Duskfogs}. You command these creatures as your thralls.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Dead Mist Lord [Lichdom]
entries: You have reached the pinnacle of Necromancy and transformed yourself into a lich. However, your lichdom has become corrupted by the all-consuming Dead Mists, leaving you as a gaseous, incorporeal wraith. You gain the following benefits in addition to those of your {@classFeature Lichdom|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|20} feature.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

entries.name: Gaseous Body
entries: Your lich form is gaseous and indistinct. You can enter and occupy the spaces of other creatures. Additionally, you can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and even mere cracks, though you treat liquids as though they were solid surfaces.

entries.name: Fly Speed
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. You can't fall and remain hovering in the air even when you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Master of the Mists
entries: Once on each of your turns when you deal Necrotic damage to an enemy with your {@classFeature Charnel Touch|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|1} or a Necromancer spell, you drain some of the target's life essence with the Dead Mists. You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d6} + your Intelligence modifier, up to a maximum of the Necrotic damage dealt.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Death Knight
entries: {@i Crush Your Foes with Your Iron Fist}

Some Necromancers are content to sit in dusty tombs with moldering tomes, occasionally picking apart a battlefield for fresh ingredients and new company. By contrast, Death Knights are predators among scavengers, seizing their goals through a melding of magic and traditional combat. Bolstered with dark energies and sturdy armor, the Death Knight wields weapons edged with death itself. They are simultaneously the vanguard and general of their Undead forces, unafraid of getting their hands dirty when necessary.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.
In addition, you can cast one of your cantrips that has a casting time of an action in place of one of those attacks.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Overcharged Thralls
entries: When one of your thralls is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or you release it, you regain a number of expended {@classFeature Charnel Touch|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|1} points equal to your Necromancer level.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Imperator [Lichdom]
entries: You have reached the pinnacle of Necromancy and transformed yourself into a lich. Due to your martial capabilities and inner nexus of necromantic power, you have transformed into an imperator lich—an Undead creature unmatched in both arcane and combat prowess. You gain the following benefits in addition to those of your Lichdom feature.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

entries.name: Two Extra Attacks
entries: You can attack three times instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.

entries.name: Peerless Necrotic Damage
entries: When you deal Necrotic damage with {@classFeature Charnel Touch|Necromancer|ValdaSpire24|1} or a Necromancer spell, it ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Demon Brand
entries: {@i Harness the Demon Within You}

Captains bearing an abyssal Demon Brand have struck the darkest of pacts: binding their soul to a demonic entity that periodically takes hold of their body. On the battlefield, they forgo the companionship of a Cohort and rely on a flickering symbiosis between themselves and their demon. The demon and Captain are two halves of the same creature, sharing a single body and parts of one soul.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Blindsight
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet while shape-shifted and in your normal form.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Instinctive Transformation
entries: When you take damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to shape-shift into the demon or return to your normal form. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the triggering damage.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Abyssal Regeneration
entries: At the start of each of your turns, the demon regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 5 plus your Charisma modifier if it is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Detective
entries: {@i Chase Down Clues and Crack the Mystery}

Prowling at the edge of darkness, Detectives chase down clues and pull on threads to unravel conspiracies that bring darkness into the world. Sometimes, this requires that you infiltrate a cult's secret meetings, other times it calls on you to reconstruct a person's last moments at a murder scene. No matter what the mystery, however, you know that there is always an explanation.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Predictive Intuition
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can examine the movements of a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Until the start of your next turn, you can add {@dice 1d6} to attack rolls you make against the target, and the target subtracts {@dice 1d6} from all its attack rolls against you. Once you use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on a target, you can't use it on that target again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Interrogator's Instinct
entries: Your sleuthing experience grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Enchantment Detection
entries: You can discern if a creature is cursed, possessed, or has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Illusion Detection
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any ability check you make to discern an illusion.

entries.name: Lie Detection
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any ability check you make to determine if you hear a deliberate lie.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Power of Deduction
entries: You can use your {@subclassFeature Predictive Intuition|Investigator|ValdaSpire24|Detective|ValdaSpire24|6} on a target an unlimited number of times.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Diabolist
entries: {@i Strike Contracts and Command the Powers of Hell}

Your call was a bellow from below, foul with brimstone and the cries of the damned. Diabolists are well-spoken advocates for demons, devils, and other Fiends, mediating their pacts and trading souls for their service. Often, Diabolists are called upon to defend portals to the underworld, safeguarding the innocent from wandering down below and trapping condemned souls within.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Soul Broker
entries: When you or an ally within 10 feet of you reduces an enemy to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can trade its soul to your fiendish patron for one of the following magical boons. The GM decides if a creature's soul can't be traded to a Fiend. The boon lasts for 10 minutes or until you use this feature to trade another soul.

entries.name: Energy Resistance
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder.

entries.name: Fortitude
entries: You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Warden level.

entries.name: Truesight
entries: You have {@sense Truesight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet.

entries.name: Skill
entries: You gain proficiency and {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 15 feet.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Hellbent Survival
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Survive|Warden|ValdaSpire24|9}, you can immediately move up to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and make two attacks with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Archdevil's Blessing
entries: Your infernal allies can grant you a boon. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can gain the benefits below for 1 minute or until you choose to end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Devil's Charm
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Hellfire Aura
entries: At the end of each of your turns, each creature you choose in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you takes {@damage 2d6} Fire damage.

entries.name: Infernal Interruption
entries: Whenever you use your {@classFeature Interrupt|Warden|ValdaSpire24|5}, you can cast {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} without a spell slot as a part of the same {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, as if the creature damaged you with the interrupted attack. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Dragon Banner
entries: {@i Defeat Your Foes with an Arsenal of Maneuvers}

Captains under the Dragon Banner are a scourge upon the battlefield. Armed with an array of lethal maneuvers, these captains cut through lesser combatants with ease, turning the tides of battle on their own, if needed. The visage of the Dragon Banner inspires fear and loyalty in equal measure, for the carnage left in a dragon warrior's wake speaks volumes of their skill.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Martial Recovery
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to regain all of your expended Battle Dice.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Bloody Spectacle
entries: Whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against an enemy, you can strike terror into nearby foes. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Maneuver save DC. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Coup de Grâce [Maneuver]
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend two Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to execute the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. If you reduce the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, this maneuver doesn't expend any Battle Dice.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Dragon Banner

entries: {@color {@style Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the {@color {@class Captain|ValdaSpire24}|3B7DAF} class|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}

entries: {@b Level 6: Martial Recovery.} Replace "all of your expended Battle Dice" with "three of your expended Battle Dice."

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Drake-Blooded
entries: {@i Channel Draconic Magic with Your Blood}

Your call was the booming roar of dragons. As such, you have struck a pact with an ancient wyrm to protect its hoard from enemies that might despoil it. In turn, the surged through your veins like fire and granted you a measure of draconic power. Fire alights at your fingertips and your eyes bear reptilian slits. As a Drake-Blooded wyrm granted you a few drops of its blood to drink, which Warden, you are a champion among half-dragons and a titan among kobolds.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Arcane Strike
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a casting of one of your Sorcerer cantrips that has a casting time of an action.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Draconic Vengeance
entries: When you take damage from a creature that is within 10 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} to unleash draconic energy in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Each creature you choose in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes damage equal to two rolls of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} plus your Constitution modifier, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage is your choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Aspect of the Greatwyrm
entries: You can wreathe yourself in a dragon's elemental might. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can gain the benefits below for 1 minute or until you choose to end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 6d6} damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage is your choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

entries.name: Elemental Fury
entries: When you deal damage with a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage. The damage is your choice of Acid, Cold, FIre, Lightning, or Poison.

entries.name: Fly Speed
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Eagle Banner
entries: {@i Deliver Shots with Pinpoint Accuracy}

With sharp eyes and even sharper arrows, Captains of the Eagle Banner seek to master bows, slings, and ballistae alike. Such Captains are just as dangerous in close range as they are perched on the horizon, for they can accurately deliver an arrow or a crossbow bolt at point blank range.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Vantage Point
entries: Your skill at scaling walls and gaining a perch above your foes grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Climb Speed
entries: You have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: High Ground Shot
entries: When you make a ranged attack roll from an elevation of 15 feet or more above the target, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the roll.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Counter-Shot [Maneuver]
entries: When an enemy you can see hits a creature with a ranged attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend one Battle Die to attempt to intercept the attack. You must be holding a Ranged weapon and the creature must be within your weapon's range to use this maneuver. Subtract the Battle Die from the attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Hundred-Arrow Volley
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action with a Ranged weapon, you can replace one of your attacks with a flurry of projectiles in one of the following ways.

entries.name: Arrow Rain
entries: Choose a point within your weapon's range. You launch several projectiles that rain down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on that point. Make a separate ranged attack roll against each target in that {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}.

entries.name: Scatter Shot
entries: You launch several projectiles in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Make a separate ranged attack roll against each target in that {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Eagle Banner

entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action with a Ranged weapon, you can replace one of your attacks with a flurry of projectiles in one of the following ways.

entries.name: Arrow Rain
entries: Choose a point within your weapon's range. You launch several projectiles that rain down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on that point. Make a separate ranged attack roll against each target in that {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}.

entries.name: Scatter Shot
entries: You launch several projectiles in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Make a separate ranged attack roll against each target in that {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Exterminator
entries: {@i Slay Vampires, Werewolves, and Other Terrible Creatures}

An Exterminator suffers no monster to live. Trained in the art of slaying Aberrations, Fiends, and Undead, you stand against evil where others falter, and draw your blade before others recognize a threat. Grand schemes and plots are less important than retribution against monsters which stalk the night, and your thirst for such retribution is unquenchable. There is always another werewolf to be slain, another vampire to be staked, another demon to be banished; people rarely thank you, but you find satisfaction enough in your work.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Monster Slayer
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make one attack with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain one expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Silvered Edge
entries: Your monster-killing expertise grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Flexible Mastery
entries: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the {@itemMastery Sap|XPHB} or {@itemMastery Vex|XPHB} property for that attack.

entries.name: Supernatural Strikes
entries: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Killer Instinct
entries: You can use your {@classFeature Exploit Weakness|Investigator|ValdaSpire24|5} twice on your turn, but can't use it against the same target more than once.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Feylost
entries: {@i Master Your Magical Mood Swings}

The Feywild is a labyrinth of winding, magical paths, leading to delightful glades and nightmarish grottos alike. Mortals that wander there often become lost, vanishing for decades before returning without having aged a day. However, they return with infectious fey enchantments that sometimes overwhelm their minds and the minds of those nearby.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Misty Pathways
entries: You can cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} without a spell slot.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Irresistible Mood
entries: When a creature deals damage to you that causes you to become {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give the creature the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your Maneuver save DC at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Mercurial
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one Battle Die to activate any Fey Mood option of your choice. This mood lasts for 1 minute. If you already have a Fey Mood active or you become {@status Bloodied|XPHB} while this mood is active, you can have both moods active at once.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Forgeknights' Guild
entries: {@i Superheat Your Weapons and Strike with Explosions}

To Craftsmen of the Forgeknights' Guild, heat is not merely integral to forging, curing, and welding gear, it is a weapon in its own right. The swing of a white-hot blade bites not only with steel, but with flame. A Forgeknight carries the intensity of a forge with them, storing it in their armor and building it up in their weapons, before unleashing it in a scorching blast.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Explosive Armory
entries: When you create or modify a Masterwork Weapon, you can add the {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property to any weapon that deals Fire damage. This property uses the following rules.

entries.name: Melee Explosions
entries: You can add the {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property to a Melee weapon. When you use this property with a Melee weapon, the explosion is centered on a point within your reach, and you take no damage from the explosion.

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: You can use the following calculation for the save DC of your {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property: 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Scorching Steel
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal {@damage 2d10} Fire damage to the attacker. You must be wearing Masterwork armor to use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Fire Burst
entries: While holding your Portable Forge, you can cast {@spell Fireball|XPHB}, centered on yourself, without a spell slot or components (DC 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). You take no damage from this spell.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Masterwork Bonus. You regain one expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Fragrant Magic
entries: {@i Choke Foes and Enchant Allies}

Magic based on the swirling smoke of strong-smelling herbs has been practiced since the time of ancient elves. Today, the discipline, a mix of aromatherapy and mystical arcana, is kept alive by the so-called "perfumed Witches", who can purify the body and still the mind with their collection of fragrances and herbal smokes. Their Fragrant Magic, however, is not always evident. Sometimes, it would appear their magic is more about relaxation and meditation, while other times, they summon foul clouds that disorientate and kill.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Aromamancy
entries: You can manipulate your magical fragrances to alter your magic, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Incense Casting
entries: When you cast a Witch spell, you can burn a stick of incense to cast it without spell components. A Witch spell you cast in this way can't be affected by {@spell Counterspell|XPHB}. If the spell requires Material components that have a cost specified in the spell, you must burn incense of equal value. A block of incense is worth 2 GP and contains 10 sticks of incense, each worth 2 SP.

entries.name: Perfumed Charisma
entries: You can expend a spell slot as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create and apply a magical perfume to yourself. For 1 hour, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all Charisma checks made to influence a creature within 5 feet of yourself.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Dizzying Fog
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can release a cloud of multi-hued smoke in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature you choose within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, a {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Olfactory Aura
entries: You are constantly surrounded by a flowery fog in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Whenever an {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it can add a {@dice d4} to the roll.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gingerbread Magic
entries: {@i Live in a Candyland}

Witches that learn the fine details of Gingerbread Magic become masters in all things confectionery. Some Witches, particularly those with a sweet tooth, use their magic to delight others. Evil gingerbread Witches, by contrast, have a penchant for cruelty, and use their delectable powers to tempt others into traps or transform valuables into sweet treats.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Sugar Rush
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can give an {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} you touch a burst of quickly-fading energy. The {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its next turn.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Sugar-Coat
entries: When a creature that you can see hits you with an attack roll using a weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to transform its weapon into a harmless duplicate made of candy. You choose the type of candy it is made out of, whether it be marshmallow, cotton candy, or gingerbread. You take no damage from the attack. The weapon remains transformed and unable to deal damage until the end of the attacker's turn. The attacker can make attacks using other weapons or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} as normal.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 3+ spell slot (no action required).

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Candy Land
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can transform an area into a field of confectionary delights. Choose a point you can see within 120 feet. For 1 minute, a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of magic centered on that point transforms every nonmagical object entirely within the area that isn't being worn or carried into an edible candy replica. Structures become gingerbread houses, trees are made of chocolate, and so on. The GM decides the type of candy into which objects are transformed. Candy objects have no damage threshold and {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to all damage. A candy object reverts to its original material at the end of the duration or if it leaves the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, unless it is eaten.

The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} lasts for 1 minute, until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or if you dismiss it (no action required). Additionally, everything inside the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} appears to be joyous and colorful. Whenever you or an {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} starts its turn inside the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, it regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. A creature doesn't gain this benefit if it has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Godsworn
entries: {@i Wield Divine Power to Protect the Weak}

The whispers of gods, the ringing of bells, and the meter of hymns called you, compelling you to swear an oath of protection. With your blade, you defend temples, holy sites, and other sacred ground, and with your shield, you protect pilgrims as they make their grand journeys. Your purpose is grander than just one life, and you look forward to seeing what designs the gods have set on your travels.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Benediction
entries: You can cast any of the following spells once without a spell slot: {@spell Daylight|XPHB}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB}, and {@spell Zone of Truth|XPHB}. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this feature. Once you cast a spell using this feature, you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Selfless Survival
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and not killed outright, you can expend the use of your {@classFeature Survive|Warden|ValdaSpire24|9} to prevent its demise.
The creature drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead and regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Warden level.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Sainted Mantle
entries: You can wreathe yourself in divine protection. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can gain the benefits below for 1 minute or until you choose to end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Radiant Regeneration
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half your Warden level plus your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Spirit Guardians
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you take to use this feature, you cast {@spell Spirit Guardians|XPHB} without a spell slot. When you cast it in this way, its duration is 1 minute and doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gourmand
entries: {@i Cook Monsters into Culinary Masterpieces}

Gourmands travel the land in search of the perfect flavor. To this end, they scrounge up rare ingredients from far-off continents, hunt monsters for unique proteins, and tinker with their recipes wherever they travel.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Carve [Maneuver]
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend two Battle Dice as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to butcher the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. If the creature's type is listed on the Monster Meal table, you gain the related benefit for 1 hour.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Quick Snack
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can eat a snack to use your Breather (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
You can also restore your use of it by expending one Battle Die (no action required).

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gourmet Ingredients
entries: When you prepare your Monster Meal, you can choose one of the following benefits for each creature that eats the meal until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Hero Sauce
entries: The creature gains {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. It can have this instance of {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} and another instance at one time.

entries.name: Munchkin Spice
entries: The creature chooses one of its ability scores, which increases by 2, to a maximum of 22.

entries.name: Wish Bone
entries: The creature can cast one spell of level 5 or lower that has a casting time of an action without a spell slot.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gourmand

entries: {@color {@style Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the {@color {@class Vagabond|ValdaSpire24Extras}|63A7A0} class|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}

entries: {@b Level 10: Quick Snack.} At the start of each of your turns, you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, roll it, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending one Battle Die (no action required).

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Green Magic
entries: {@i Wield Nature and an Empowered Familiar}

Plants, nature, and things that grow are the domain of Green Magic. Normally a branch of arcana championed by Druids, some Witches have a close tie to the powers of Green Magic and can coax plants and animals to do their bidding.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Twin Familiar
entries: When you summon your familiar, you can divide its spirit into two bodies. When summoned in this way, your familiar is two identical creatures that share a single pool of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Your twin familiars act on subsequent turns. You can use your Quick Attack twice on the same turn, using an action to command one twin and a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command the other. A spell or feature that targets or dismisses your familiar affects both twins.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Vital Nourishment
entries: You exude an aura of Green Magic that restores and reinvigorates life around you. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, plant life within 120 feet of where you finished your {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} grows as if a month had passed with abundant food, water, and other necessities. If the plants would produce fruits, berries, or vegetables, the plants grow enough food to feed six creatures for one day.

Additionally, choose up to six creatures you can see at the end of the rest. Those creatures each gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Witch level + your Charisma modifier. You can also end one of the following conditions affecting each creature: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Sacrificial Familiar
entries: Whenever you are targeted by an attack while your familiar is within 5 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to command it to dive in the way of the attack, causing the attack to target your familiar instead.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Grenadier
entries: {@i Blow Up Anything in Your Way}

You believe that virtually all problems can be solved with the careful application of high-explosives, and will go to great lengths to prove this thesis. Demolitions are your expertise, and anything that can cause explosions at long range is your instrument. If you must, you can make do with an ordinary gun, but it's simply not as satisfying as blowing your enemies into smithereens.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Configurable Blast
entries: When you use a weapon's {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, you can choose one of the following benefits for that attack.

entries.name: Demolition Blast
entries: The explosion deals double damage to objects and ignores the damage threshold of objects.

entries.name: Elemental Blast
entries: You cause the explosion to deal Acid, Cold, Lightning, or Thunder damage rather than its normal damage type.

entries.name: Incendiary Blast
entries: Flammable objects in the area of the explosion that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Take Cover
entries: Each creature you choose gains the benefits of your {@classFeature Evasion|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|7} feature while it is within 5 feet of you.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Clusterbomb
entries: When you use a weapon's {@itemMastery Explode|ValdaGunslinger} property, you can fire a Clusterbomb. The explosion is a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6} Fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}. A Huge or smaller creature that takes damage from the Clusterbomb has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending four Risk Dice (no action required).

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gun Tank
entries: {@i Be Huge and Wield Huge Guns}

Be bigger, be badder, and be tougher, and no one will stand in your way. You are a living siege engine, a titan of muscle, brandishing weapons most people are incapable of lifting. Armed with these devastating firearms, you wade into the field of battle, bombarding and destroying those foolish enough to oppose you.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Thick-Skulled
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Bulletproof
entries: When you use your {@optfeature Bite the Bullet|ValdaGunslinger} maneuver, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gatling Shot
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you hit an enemy with a ranged attack using a weapon, you can make another attack with the weapon against the same target. This attack is always made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, regardless of circumstance. If this attack hits, you can make another attack against the same target. You can repeat this attack until you miss or make a total of five attacks against the target.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Gun-Ko Master
entries: {@i Wield Your Gun as a Total Weapon}

The ancient art of gun-ko is passed through generations of Gunslingers who study the gun as a perfect weapon and meditate on its intricacies. This path is not for the impatient or the faint of heart, but those who practice diligently can transform the gun into an extension of themselves, striking and shooting with mesmerizing speed.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Lightning Disarm [Maneuver]
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of you is holding a weapon, you can expend one Risk Die as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to take it. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or you take the weapon from it after a series of rapid movements. You must have a free hand to use this maneuver.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Wall Dash [Maneuver]
entries: You can expend one Risk Die to take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Until the end of your turn, you have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and you can move across vertical surfaces while leaving your hands free.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Predictive Dodge
entries: Your reflexes are honed enough to dodge incoming bullets. You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to choose one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the benefits of the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action against the target's ranged attack rolls and its effects that force you to make a Dexterity saving throw.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Flash Assault
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make one ranged attack with a weapon and one melee attack using the {@itemMastery Bludgeon|ValdaSpire24Extras} property of that weapon. You can move between these attacks. If you hit a Large or smaller creature with both attacks, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending two Risk Dice (no action required).

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Holy Icon
entries: {@i Champion a Divine Cause}

Captains adorned with a Holy Icon are the champions of a god or ideology, embarking on minor quests and holy crusades in furtherance of their ideals. Though not imbued with grand divine powers, they command a suite of lesser miracles to heal and strengthen their allies for the long road ahead and a surety of purpose to propel them onward.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Zealous Fervor
entries: Your fanaticism motivates your allies, granting the following benefits.

entries.name: Strength of Spirit
entries: When you use your Blitz feature to command an ally that has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, it can reroll its save against the effect causing that condition, ending the condition on itself on a success.

entries.name: Radiant Strike
entries: When you use your Blitz feature to command an ally to make an attack, the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage on a hit.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Aura of Reprieve
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can create a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you, which lasts for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. When you or an ally starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, that creature gains one of the following benefits of its choice. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend two Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

entries.name: Temporary Hit Points
entries: The creature gains {@dice 2d8} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Resistance
entries: The creature has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to a damage type of its choice other than Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: End Condition
entries: The creature ends one condition on itself: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Raise Cohort
entries: You can cast the spell {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB} without a spell slot. If you revive a creature that was your Cohort, you also cast the spell without Material components. The creature becomes your Cohort once again, without an 8-hour initiation period.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Houndmaster
entries: {@i Travel the Land with a Good Dog at Your Side}

Stretching ever onward, the road is grueling and unforgiving. But, as Houndmasters know, it need not be lonely. A single dog, mankind's most loyal companion, can make all the difference in the world. Houndmasters are never found without their dogs, who both serve as inseparable companions and fearsome defenders as the need arises.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Hound's Instincts
entries: Your dog has a sixth sense for danger.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: The hound has {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet.

entries.name: Supernatural Scent
entries: The hound can sense if a creature is possessed, magically disguised, or shape-shifted.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Loyal Redirection
entries: When a creature you can see hits your hound while it is within 5 feet of yourself with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to force the attack to hit you instead. Alternatively, your hound can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to use this feature to cause an attack that hits you to hit it instead.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Old Dog, New Tricks
entries: Your dog has learned how to perform dangerous combat maneuvers.

entries.name: Battle Dice
entries: Your hound has two battle dice, which are d10s. A battle die is expended when your hound uses it. It regains all of its expended battle dice when it finishes a short or long rest, or when it rolls initiative.

entries.name: Maneuvers
entries: Your dog knows two of your maneuvers that don't have a prerequisite. The hound's Bite counts as using a Melee weapon for the purpose of maneuvers.

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: If a maneuver requires a saving throw, it uses your Maneuver save DC.

subclassFeaturesFull.name: Houndmaster

entries: {@color {@style Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the {@color {@class Vagabond|ValdaSpire24Extras}|63A7A0} class|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}
{@color {@style Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}
{@color {@style The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.|small-caps; large; bold}|e40707}

entries.name: Cross-Compatability Modifications
entries: {@b Level 3: Faithful Hound.} The Hound is your Cohort and uses the rules in the Cohort feature. The Hound uses your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls. The Hound also has the Martial Excellence trait.
{@b Level 5: Martial Excellence.} The hound has a +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases to +2 at Captain level 9, and +3 at Captain level 13.
